coastal.title: Drivers should expect major delays on Sea to Sky during GranFondo
coastal.description: The Sea to Sky Highway between Horseshoe Bay and Whistler is limited to single-lane traffic until 4 p.m. on Saturday.

prince-george.title: Prince George to celebrate life of 3-year-old hockey superfan at local arena
prince-george.description: Mavrik Turnbull's family is hosting a public celebration of life at the CN Centre in Prince George following the hockey superfan's cancer battle, which captured the hearts of the hockey community throughout B.C.
